texts.Why do you want to join Dust?: Dust is building the layer I already live in: getting agents deployed into real company workflows, not demos. My daily work since 2023 is exactly that - I run a production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines) in public: MCP connectors, RAG over a 10-year knowledge base, CRM automation, 100+ routines, published reliability evals (0/17 high-risk actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs). The customer-facing half is my native ground: 15+ years founder/BD, 10,000+ founder calls, enterprise advisory for subsidiaries of Foxconn and ANA Airlines, government/bank relations across SE Asia. AI Deployment Strategist is that combination in one seat. EU citizen (Poland) based in Lisbon - no visa needed, happy to relocate to Paris and be office-based.
